meta.name: story-short-analyze
meta.description: 短篇网文拆文。拆解爆款短篇小说（番茄短篇 / 故事会 / 知乎盐选 / 追妻 / 世情 / 重生 / 虐渣等通俗题材）的故事核、结构、情感线、反转设计、写作手法、共鸣层次。单一全量拆解管道：跑完 Stage 2-6 产出完整拆文报告，落盘到 拆文库/{书名}/，下游 story-short-write 同时读拆文报告 + 情节节点 + 写作手法 + 原文 + _meta.json 写下一篇。触发方式：/story-short-analyze、/短篇拆文、「拆短篇」「拆这篇短文」「短篇拆文」「精细拆解短篇」「8000 字短篇拆解」「番茄短篇拆文」「故事会拆解」「盐言故事拆解」「分析这篇短篇」——均进入同一管道。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解爆款短篇，提炼结构与写作手法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让自己的短篇网文更懂爆款的套路
copy.tagline_en: Break down viral short stories and extract their storytelling blueprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to write short web novels that resonate like the bestsellers.

howto.what: 装上后，你把一篇短篇小说原文交给它，它会拆解故事核、结构、情感线、反转、写作手法和共鸣层次，产出拆文报告、情节节点清单、写作手法分析和元数据，存入「拆文库/书名/」文件夹。
howto.when: 当你说「拆短篇」「分析这篇短篇」等指令，或提供原文文件路径时触发。少于1.5万字直接拆，超过会先询问是否按短篇继续。

say.text: 帮我拆这篇短文，书名《追妻》，来源番茄短篇
say.note: 按番茄短篇题材开始拆解

say.text: 拆短篇：原文贴在这里，8000字，直接开始
say.note: 字数达标，直接进短篇管道

say.text: 分析这篇短篇，重点看反转设计

howto.what_en: After installation, when you give it a short story text, it analyzes the story core, structure, emotional arc, twists, writing techniques, and resonance layers. It produces a deconstruction report, plot node list, technique analysis, and metadata, saving them to the '拆文库/{bookname}/' folder.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say commands like '拆短篇' or '分析这篇短篇', or provide a file path to the original text. Texts under 15,000 words are processed directly; longer ones prompt a confirmation first.

say_en.text: Please deconstruct this story, title 'Pursuing Wife', source Tomato Short Story
say_en.note: Starts deconstruction with the tomato genre lens.

say_en.text: Deconstruct this short story; original pasted here, 8,000 words, start now
say_en.note: Word count qualifies, enters short-story pipeline.

say_en.text: Analyze this short story, focus on the twist design
